title: 第181章 清修士第180章 狩猎诅咒
lines: 眼见几位宁芙面露难色，赫尔墨斯直接抛出了筹码，那是宙斯的亲许：来日功成，册封她们为执掌海阿得斯星团的星宿之神。
“成交。这买卖，倒值得搏一把。”
为首的宁芙沉吟了片刻，终于点了点头。
春去秋来。
狄娥尼索斯在宁芙们的悉心照料下平安长大。
他整日与山野间的萨堤罗斯为伍，拜了西勒诺斯为师，终长成了一个雌雄莫辨的美少年。
他的身量日渐拔高，那纤细的腰肢、圆润的肩头、修长的脖颈，无一不散发着令人心旌摇曳的魅力。那张绝美的面容上，既有少年的英气，又带着少女般的柔媚，让人分不清他究竟是男是女。
说起来，狄娥尼索斯自幼便显露出异能。毕竟，他是最契合宙斯设想，继承了神王浓厚神血的准神。
再凶悍的恶兽，到了他手里也温顺如绵羊。其神力与法术底蕴，更是深不可测。
甚至在年少时，他无意间捣鼓那些葡萄藤，还误打误撞地酿出了世上第一坛葡萄酒。
那酒液呈现出琥珀般的色泽，散发着醉人的芬芳，入口甘醇，回味悠长。
“狄娥尼索斯，你蹲那儿发什么呆呢？”
一个轻佻的声音在他身后响起。
狄娥尼索斯回过头，只见他的好友安斐罗斯正斜倚在一棵大树上，那张英俊的面孔上挂着一副玩世不恭的笑容。
“啊，安斐罗斯啊。这不，刚谱了首新曲子。”
狄娥尼索斯扬了扬手中的葡萄藤，那张绝美的面容上浮现出一抹淡然的笑意。
“啧，兄弟你好香....不是、快别摆弄你那劳什子乐谱了，走！哥们今儿约了几个帅气美艳的宁芙，咱们好好乐一乐。”
“算了，指不定你们又想作什么妖。我劝你收敛点，人在做，神在看。”
狄娥尼索斯摇了摇头。
安斐罗斯翻了个白眼，把他的警告当成了耳旁风。
在他看来，萨堤罗斯一族的天职就是播种人间，四处留情。虽说他身上的宁芙血统更纯正些，充其量算个“荣誉萨堤罗斯”，但该玩的作风是一点没落下。
“拉倒吧。要让我如你这般“安斐罗斯！狄娥尼索斯！大祸临头了！山里闹瘟疫了！”，那和死了有什么区别？”
狄娥尼索斯看着自家青梅竹马这副浪荡样，深感无力地叹了口气。
‘迟早踢到铁板。’
任凭狄娥尼索斯如何泼冷水，安斐罗斯还是带着那帮萨堤罗斯，在山林里扯起了荒唐的肉林大戏。
他们荒淫无度，痕迹留得漫山遍野。消遣完尼萨山还不满足，竟还把贼手伸向了邻近的荒山。
彻底玩嗨了的散兵游勇，宿醉未醒，稀里糊涂地就闯进了阿耳忒弥斯的属山。
坏就坏在，这帮萨堤罗斯和森林宁芙早就灌马尿灌坏了脑子，哪分得清东南西北？他们只管大口喝酒，可劲儿地颠鸾倒凤。
身为贞洁之神，阿耳忒弥斯眼里最揉不得沙子。
这天，她刚一踏入领地，便闻到了一股子令人作呕的腥臊气。那气味掺杂着酒气和体液的味道，弥漫在整片山林之间，将原本清新的空气污染得污浊不堪。
那张冷艳绝伦的面容上顿时笼罩上了一层寒霜，眼眸中翻涌起滔天的怒意。
她本是带队巡山，同德鲁伊和精灵们一道调节万物生息的。谁承想，一进山就瞧见自家圣地被各种污秽之物泼得泥泞不堪，地上散落着酒瓶和衣物，一片狼藉。
content_en:
Seeing the expressions of confusion on the faces of several nymphs, Hermes directly threw out the bargaining chip, which was Zeus's personal promise: if they succeed in the future, they will be canonized as the gods of the stars in charge of the Hyades star cluster.
"Deal. This deal is worth a try."
The leader Nymph pondered for a moment and finally nodded.
Spring passes and autumn comes.
Dionysus grew up safely under the careful care of the nymphs.
He spent all his time with Satyrus in the mountains and fields, and became a disciple of Silenus. He eventually grew into a handsome boy who could not tell the difference between male and female.
His stature is getting taller and taller, and his slender waist, round shoulders, and slender neck all exude a charm that makes people's hearts sway. That beautiful face has both the heroism of a young man and the tenderness of a girl, making it impossible to tell whether he is a boy or a girl.
Speaking of which, Dionysus has shown supernatural powers since he was a child. After all, he is the quasi-god who best fits Zeus's vision and has inherited the rich divine blood of the God King.
No matter how fierce the beast is, it is as docile as a sheep in his hands. Its divine power and magical heritage are even more unfathomable.
Even when he was young, he accidentally tinkered with those grapevines and made the world's first wine by mistake.
The wine has an amber-like color, exudes an intoxicating fragrance, is sweet in the mouth, and has a long aftertaste.
"Dionysus, why are you sitting there in a daze?"
A frivolous voice sounded behind him.
Dionysus turned around and saw his friend Amphilus leaning against a big tree, with a cynical smile on his handsome face.
"Ah, Amphilus. No, I just composed a new song."
Dionysus raised the grapevine in his hand, and an indifferent smile appeared on his beautiful face.
"Tsk, brother, you smell so good...No, stop playing with your music score, let's go! I have made an appointment with some handsome and beautiful nymphs today, let's have a good time."
"Forget it, maybe you want to be a monster again. I advise you to restrain yourself. God is watching what people do."
Dionysus shook his head.
Amphilos rolled his eyes and ignored his warning.
In his opinion, the vocation of the Satyros family is to sow seeds in the world and show mercy everywhere. Although the nymph blood in him is purer and he can be regarded as an "honorary satyrus" at best, his style of play has not fallen behind at all.
"Pull me down. Make me like you "Amphilos!" Dionysus! Disaster is coming! There's a plague in the mountains! "What's the difference between that and death?"
Dionysus looked at his childhood sweetheart's dissolute appearance and sighed helplessly.
‘Sooner or later the iron plate will be kicked. ’
No matter how hard Dionysus poured cold water on them, Amphilos still led the group of satyros to start a ridiculous carnival drama in the mountains and forests.
They were dissolute and extravagant, leaving traces all over the mountains and plains. Not satisfied with having fun in Nisa Mountain, he even extended his hand to the neighboring barren mountains.
The stragglers, who were completely intoxicated and hungover, stumbled into the mountain belonging to Artemis.
The bad thing is, these satyros and forest nymphs have already ruined their brains by feeding them horse urine. How can they tell the difference between east, west and north? They just drink a lot of wine, but they are very drunk.
As the god of chastity, Artemis has the most unruly eyes.
That day, as soon as she stepped into the territory, she smelled a disgusting smell. The smell was mixed with the smell of alcohol and body fluids, permeating the entire mountain forest, polluting the originally fresh air.
That cold and charming face was suddenly covered with a layer of frost, and the eyes were filled with overwhelming anger.
She originally led a team to patrol the mountains, and worked with the druids and elves to regulate the growth of all things. Who would have thought that as soon as they entered the mountain, they would see that their holy place was muddy with all kinds of filth, and the ground was littered with wine bottles and clothes, making it a mess.
